rows.RiskSummary: User runs assay at altitudes greater than 1600m
rows.RequirementText: The Product, when used within the HER2 BMA CDx Assay System, must generate acceptable staining when used within the BOND-III altitude specifications.
rows.OverarchingAcceptanceCriteria: To pass, when stained within the BOND-III altitude specifications (0-1600m) using either the default HIER or alternative HIERs (ER1, 97°C for 35 mins, and ER1, 96 °C for 25 mins), 100% of sections stained should demonstrate no evidence of altitude staining artifact impacting slide interpretation.
